narrative_summary: Implementing a tip switch in production lines L6, L7, and L8 that disables automatic mode and allows machine speed pre-selection.

kips.text: Two new PLC variables were added: a boolean for tip switch status (tipptaster_linie) and a REAL for machine speed selection (db_allgemein.r32._10)
The tip switch status variable is located at Data Block 1804, Offset 2, Bit 3, using S7TCP32 driver with Bool data type
The machine speed variable is located at Data Block 1804, Offset 160, with setpoint limits of 10 to 200 pcs/min
When the tip switch is active, the machine must not be switched to automatic mode
A LockMachineAutoMode interlocking function was created combining the machine running state and tip switch status with OR logic
Language entries were added in German, English, and Italian for both the machine speed label and the interlocking warning message
The Auto mode buttons in the Start and Pop_Favorites screens were modified to use the LockMachineAutoMode interlocking with a warning text
Machine speed input fields were added to the appropriate machine master data screens with display authorization level 33 and Machine parametrization permission
The implementation is identical across all projects covering 12 machine numbers in lines L6, L7, and L8
When the tip switch is active, the operator can pre-select a machine speed within the configured setpoint limits
